notes:
I couldn't write these notes. When I tried to fetch the commentary pages (Enduring Word, Gill, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary, Precept Austin, Wesley, Calvin and Spurgeon's *Treasury of David* on Psalm 82), the system said I had no web lookups left for this turn. None of the pages loaded, so I have no sourced material on any verse.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point. Writing notes from my own memory would break both rules, so I've left them out entirely.

**What happens next:** If you send the request again in a new turn, I'll do the research. I'll start with the verse-by-verse commentaries you listed. Then I'll look for:
- **Protestant differences**, mainly on who the "gods" are in vv. 1 and 6: Calvin and Gill (Reformed and Baptist), Wesley (Methodist), Spurgeon (Baptist), and Lutheran sources.
- **Modern scholarship:** Bible Odyssey and NET Bible notes on the "divine assembly" reading.
- **Catholic and Orthodox readings:** New Advent (the Church Fathers) and Catholic.com, especially on v. 6 and how it links to John 10:34.
- **Popular modern teaching:** GotQuestions on the word of faith "little gods" use of v. 6.

Each note will be laid out verse by verse with its URL.
